intro.title: Minor keys
intro.text: A minor uses the same key signature as C major (no sharps or flats) but centres on A. It sounds darker.

intro.title: Harmonic minor
intro.text: Raising the 7th note gives the harmonic minor: in A minor, G becomes G♯. E minor works the same way: one sharp (F♯), with D♯ raised.

intro.title: G sharp
intro.text: The black key just right of G. Here your thumb slides down onto it.
